corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The move carefully distinguishes immediate experiential warrant from indefeasibility, explicitly allowing genuine factual contradiction to overturn belief and thereby presenting a coherent, recoverable, appropriately qualified epistemic position rather than an unrestricted appeal to private conviction. Principal limitation: Its central warrant remains substantially asserted, because the passage offers no representative account of why an experience identified as divine should receive this epistemic status or how misleading evidence is reliably distinguished from an actual defeater. Live burden: Craig still needs an independently intelligible method for identifying veridical religious experience and resolving conflicts between personal seeming and public historical evidence without insulating either category from meaningful correction. Locked score: The strong/competent band reflects excellent conceptual clarity and calibration alongside limited evidential development and only subsidiary contact with the debate's central historical burden.

corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The stipulated discovery directly tests Craig's own defeater condition, precisely isolates a publicly checkable contradiction of bodily resurrection, and charitably asks whether experiential warrant would yield under the strongest relevant factual counterexample. Principal limitation: Because the example is hypothetical and expressly conclusive, it demonstrates the structure of falsifiability more effectively than it supplies present evidence against resurrection, leaving the practical standards for authenticating such remains unexplored. Live burden: O'Connor must connect this sharp conditional test to realistic historical evidence or a general adjudication rule explaining when less-than-conclusive public evidence should outweigh powerful personal experience. Locked score: The very strong band reflects exceptional responsiveness, coherence, precision, and charitable contact with the stated qualification, while recognizing that the move advances a subsidiary falsification test rather than independently resolving the historical case.
